capability: Record every try so any version can return
title: Every try gets a tick.

hook.picture: Close on the whale reshaping a line; a pod answers ✓; the whale reshapes again and the good shape and its ✓ vanish.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Which version actually worked? I overwrote it last night.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: engineer the morning after a prompt session

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three-times device: three overwrites, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½, each erasing a ✓.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each try paints over the last one.

stakes.body: The good version is lost; hours redone; nobody can say what changed.

solution_hint: Write down every try and its result.

metaphor.body: Each new shape of the line drops a tick on a strip below, carrying a tiny copy of the shape and its result, so any tick brings that shape back.

steps.picture: Each new shape of the line drops a tick on the strip, with a tiny copy of the shape and its ✓ or ✕.
Push-in: the loop runs on its own: line, pod, result, reshape, tick; it stops when a reading clears a gate.
steps.words: It loops until the bar is met.
steps.sound: clicks in rhythm, then a chord

steps.picture: The whale taps an old tick; that exact old shape returns to the line.
steps.words: Any tick brings that try back.

steps.picture: The strip lies under the line, ticks in a row.
steps.words: The tick strip is a ledger.

real_case.claim: One logged test of meta-prompting-framework: 6 real API calls, 3,998 tokens, 89.7 seconds, 2 complete iterations, with strict and lenient variants kept.

honest_limit.picture: A tick records a shape with a hidden kink; its reading cleared the gate. Slow push to the kink.
honest_limit.words: The record is perfect. The run is not.

not_this.body: A full record is not a good result.

ending_pattern.body: FELT close shot after many reshapes; the whale taps the tick with the ✓ and the exact line from bar 2 snaps back; pod ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: In FELT the good shape vanished under the next edit; in the same shot it now returns from its tick.

end_belief.body: Keep every try. Then you can go back.
